//regions: The Supabase project lives in ap-northeast-2 (Seoul). Running functions anywhere else puts a cross-Pacific round trip in front of every query, which matters here because pages read provenance across several joined tables. icn1 is Seoul.
//crons: Vercel Hobby caps cron frequency at once per day. Payment reconciliation wants every 2-5 minutes, and since eSewa ePay v2 provides no reliable server-to-server notification, this cron is the primary confirmation channel rather than a safety net. Until the plan is upgraded, three things carry it: the return handler confirms synchronously for customers whose browser comes back, the order status page polls the database itself, and the admin reconciliation queue has a Reconcile now action. On Pro, change the schedule to */5 * * * *.
